title: boechera fendleri
intro: Boechera fendleri, commonly known as Fendler's rockcress, is a perennial plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is used as a food, a medicine, and a source of bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Boechera fendleri include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
